svg.title: Repository session dependencies
svg.desc: 183 registered sessions. The upper diagram shows the base dependencies. The 167 additional OIP sessions are grouped by purpose below. The arrows above indicate direct Isabelle source dependencies. The full graph and ROOT files are linked in the README.

g.text: Auxiliary audit sessions are separate from this catalog.
Model, profile, reopening, recovery-boundary and message scopes remain distinct.
ROOT parent links describe source dependencies, not deployment or whole-implementation verification.
